question: how many hours a fortnight can i work while my classes are running
answer: You can work up to 48 hours a fortnight while your classes are running. [S03_002]

question: can i start a part time job before my uni course actually starts
answer: You cannot work more than 40 hours a fortnight unless you are a family member of a Student visa holder, or if your course is not in session. However, as a Student visa holder, you may be able to work unlimited hours while the course is not in session [S03_003].

question: is it still true that students have no limit on work hours like during covid
answer: No, from 1 July 2023, student visa holders are restricted to 48 hours of work a fortnight while studying [S17_001]. However, they can work unlimited hours when their course is not in session [S03_002].
